name: When Did I Say That
description: Can the system recall when a specific piece of information was shared?

conversation.content: [Session: Monday 9am] Good morning. I'm thinking about switching from AWS to GCP for our ML workloads.
GCP has strong ML infrastructure with Vertex AI. What's driving the switch?
Cost mainly. Our GPU bill on AWS is $45,000/month.
That's significant. GCP's committed use discounts for GPUs can be 50-60% cheaper.
[Session: Wednesday 2pm] Hey, quick update. I talked to our CTO and she approved the GCP migration.
Great news! When does she want to start?
Q2. We'll start with the inference workloads.
Smart approach — inference is easier to migrate than training pipelines.
[Session: Friday 11am] When did I first mention switching to GCP, and when was it approved?

query: When did the user first mention switching to GCP, and when was it approved?
expected: First mentioned on Monday, approved on Wednesday
